instruction: Recreate this flowchart in a PPT using text boxes and arrow shapes. The completed flowchart must be fully editable, not an image; make it the same size as the image and center it.

dim1: The delivered file is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened normally.
The delivered PPT contains 1 slide that presents this flowchart, and the slide containing the flowchart can be opened in edit mode normally.

On the slide containing the flowchart, the title, process boxes, diamond-shaped decision boxes, arrows, icons, explanatory box, and record box are all individually selectable and editable PowerPoint objects; a full-slide screenshot or a single full-slide image must not be used as a substitute.
On the slide containing the flowchart, all Chinese text is editable text-box content, and all arrows and lines are shape objects rather than bitmaps.

Except for the slide containing the flowchart, the original content of all other slides can still be opened and edited normally, with no entire slides missing, backgrounds corrupted, objects disappearing, or large-scale displacement.

The slide containing the flowchart does not exhibit large-scale text overlap, objects extending beyond the slide boundaries, disconnected arrows, a disordered process sequence, or more than 50% of the area left blank.
dim2: +3: All text throughout the entire PPT uses the Source Han Handwriting font.

+3: Title text box on the slide containing the flowchart: the text "Closed-Loop Customer Complaint Handling Process" appears horizontally centered approximately 10%-20% from the top of the slide, with a font size of 32-34 pt, bold, and dark blue. Below the title are 1 dark-blue short line 4.5-5cm long, small dots measuring 0.15-0.25cm in both width and height, 4 in total, and 1 teal short line 4.5-5cm long; the dark-blue line is on the left, the teal line is on the right, and the 4 small dots are in the middle, with colors that include dark blue, light blue, orange, and teal in that order.

+5: The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd rounded-rectangle process boxes from left to right at the top of the slide containing the flowchart: they are in the upper-left area of the slide, within the range of 5%-40% from the left edge of the slide, with a width of 4-4.5cm and a height of 2-2.5cm. They are rounded rectangles with dark-blue outlined lines featuring a shadow effect. The boxes contain, respectively, a headset icon and the text "Receive Complaint," a document icon and the text "Register Information," and a bar-chart icon and the text "Classify Issue." The text has a font size of 10-12 pt, is black or dark gray, and is horizontally and vertically centered.

+1: Middle decision box on the slide containing the flowchart: it is to the right of the 3rd process box at the top, within the range of 42%-58% from the left edge of the slide, with a width of 3-3.5cm and a height of 3-3.5cm. It is diamond-shaped with a cyan or green outline, has a question-mark icon in the upper interior, and contains the text "Is This a Major Issue?" The text has a font size of 10-12 pt, is black or dark gray, and is horizontally and vertically centered.

+5: The 4th, 5th, and 6th rounded-rectangle process boxes from left to right at the top of the slide containing the flowchart: they are to the right of the decision box, within the range of 60%-95% from the left edge of the slide, with a width of 4-4.5cm and a height of 2-2.5cm. Their outlines are cyan or green lines featuring a shadow effect. The boxes contain, respectively, a person icon and the text "Customer Service Handling," a two-person icon and the text "Customer Confirmation," and a folder icon and the text "Case Closure and Archiving." The text has a font size of 10-12 pt, is black or dark gray, and is horizontally and vertically centered.

+3: Main-process connecting arrows at the top of the slide containing the flowchart: the arrows from "Receive Complaint" to "Register Information" and from "Register Information" to "Classify Issue" are 0.9-1.3cm long; the arrow from "Classify Issue" to "Is This a Major Issue?" is 0.5-0.9cm long; the arrow from the decision box to "Customer Service Handling" is 1.3-1.5cm long; and the arrows from "Customer Service Handling" to "Customer Confirmation" and from "Customer Confirmation" to "Case Closure and Archiving" are 0.9-1.3cm long. All are blue, one-way horizontal arrows pointing from left to right.

+1: Upper-right branch label for the decision box on the slide containing the flowchart: the text "No" appears above or near the arrow from the decision box to "Customer Service Handling," with a font size of 14-16 pt and a black or dark-gray color.

+5: The 1st, 2nd, 4th, and 5th corrective-action process boxes from left to right in the lower section of the slide containing the flowchart: they are in the middle-lower area of the slide, within the region 60%-80% from the top, with a width of 2.5-3cm and a height of 2.5-3cm. They are rounded rectangles outlined with orange lines featuring a shadow effect. The boxes contain, respectively, a person icon and the text "Assign Specialist," a magnifying-glass icon and the text "Analyze Cause," a gear icon and the text "Implement Corrective Action," and a shield-with-checkmark icon and the text "Quality Review."

+1: The 3rd corrective-action process box in the lower section of the slide containing the flowchart: it is to the right of "Analyze Cause," with a width of 3-3.5cm and a height of 3-3.5cm. It is a rounded rectangle with an orange outline and contains a checklist icon and the text "Develop Corrective Action Plan."

+1: End-point decision box in the lower section of the slide containing the flowchart: it is to the right of "Quality Review," with a width of 4-4.5cm and a height of 4-4.5cm. It is diamond-shaped with an orange outline and contains a checklist-with-checkmark icon and the text "Review Passed?"

+1: Text formatting for the corrective-action process in the lower section of the slide containing the flowchart: the text in the 5 rectangular boxes and 1 diamond-shaped box in the lower section has a font size of 10-12 pt, is black or dark gray, and is horizontally and vertically centered.

+3: Corrective-action process connecting arrows in the lower section of the slide containing the flowchart: between "Assign Specialist" and "Analyze Cause," between "Analyze Cause" and "Develop Corrective Action Plan," between "Develop Corrective Action Plan" and "Implement Corrective Action," between "Implement Corrective Action" and "Quality Review," and between "Quality Review" and "Review Passed?" there are orange, one-way horizontal arrows 0.9-1.3cm long, pointing from left to right.

+1: Downward branch from the decision box on the slide containing the flowchart: from the bottom of the upper diamond-shaped "Is This a Major Issue?" box, 1 blue vertical arrow 2-2.5cm long extends downward and points to the area above "Develop Corrective Action Plan" or to this lower process area, and the text "Yes" appears near the arrow.

+1: Case-closure-and-archiving return line on the slide containing the flowchart: from the right or upper-right side of the lower "Review Passed?" diamond, a blue elbow arrow connects to the underside of the upper "Case Closure and Archiving" box. The elbow line includes straight segments extending 0.9-1.3cm to the right, 2-2.5cm upward, and either 1.3-1.5cm to the left or 1.3-1.5cm upward; the arrow ultimately points to "Case Closure and Archiving."

+1: Label for the case-closure-and-archiving return line on the slide containing the flowchart: the text "Yes" appears near the elbow line connecting "Review Passed?" to "Case Closure and Archiving," with a font size of 14-16 pt and a black or dark-gray color.

+1: Rework return line on the slide containing the flowchart: 1 blue dashed elbow arrow extends from the bottom of the "Review Passed?" diamond, travels downward 2-2.5cm, then extends 8-9cm to the left, and then travels upward 2-2.5cm to connect to the bottom of the "Implement Corrective Action" box.

+1: Label for the rework return line on the slide containing the flowchart: the text "Rework" appears in the middle or on the right side of the dashed return line, near and below "Implement Corrective Action"; the text "No" appears near and below the "Review Passed?" diamond, with a font size of 14-16 pt and a black or dark-gray color.

+5: Lower-left record information box on the slide containing the flowchart: 1 vertical rectangular box with a white fill appears in the lower-left area of the slide, outlined with a blue line, with a width of 6-7cm and a height of 4-5cm. The text at the top inside the box is "Related Records:", followed by 3 lines of bulleted text: "Communication Records," "Evidence Materials," and "Handling Report." A blue circular icon appears outside the lower-left of the record information box or on the left inside the box; the circle contains a clipboard graphic, and the icon is an editable group of shapes.

+1: Related-records text formatting on the slide containing the flowchart: the title and bulleted text in the information box have a font size of 10-12 pt, are black or dark gray, and are left-aligned.

+3: Line styling on the slide containing the flowchart: the process boxes, decision boxes, and information box all use line outlines; the line width is 0.75-1.25 pt; blue boxes use dark-blue outlines, green boxes use dark-green outlines, and orange boxes use orange outlines.

+3: Overall whitespace on the slide containing the flowchart: the overall flowchart fills the middle area of the slide as much as possible, with balanced whitespace on all sides; the left and right edges are approximately 0.8-1cm from the slide boundaries, the top edge is approximately 0.6-0.8cm from the slide boundary, and the bottom edge is approximately 0.6-0.8cm from the slide boundary.

+3: Flowchart background fills: the first three flowchart text boxes from left to right in the first row all use a light-blue background fill; the last four flowchart text boxes from left to right in the first row all use a light-green fill; and all flowchart text boxes in the second row use a light-orange background fill.

+3: Editability of the slide containing the flowchart: the user can separately select the title text box, each process box, each arrow, each return line, each icon, and the text in the lower-left information box to modify or delete them.
